candidates.original_title: Narcolepsy: biogenic amine deficits in an animal model
candidates.description: altered regional neurotransmitter and transmitter metabolite levels in the narcoleptic canine brain
candidates.citation_sentence: This study (Study 2) is an attempt to replicate previous findings 14 (Study 1) of altered regional neurotransmitter and transmitter metabolite levels in the narcoleptic canine brain
candidates.notes: Study 2 is a direct replication of Study 1 (Mefford et al., 1983). Results are mixed: DA/DOPAC in amygdala and NE in preoptic hypothalamus replicated, but DOPAC in caudate and NE in reticularis oralis failed to replicate. Overall characterization is inconclusive due to mixed signals within one experiment. Study 2 replicates some but not all findings from Study 1; DOPAC in caudate and reticularis oralis failed to replicate while DA/DOPAC in amygdala and other effects did replicate; overall pattern is mixed
